title: 24 再见鸿宇仙祖25 五杀盗
content_zh:
而灵气漩涡的所有灵气都倒卷而下，洛豪的气势也在慢慢的攀升，经过灵气的洗礼，洛豪的实力更为凝实了，结真初期巅峰的境界也巩固的更为深厚。
可以说，只要再吞下一枚草丹果，洛豪既可以突破成为结真中期，但是洛豪并没有这么做。
洛豪想的是先寻找一个炼丹炉，然后利用炼丹炉来炼制草灵丹，这样使用的效果将会加倍，当然还有一种情况就是继续这样吸收天地灵气也会让洛豪突破成为结真中期。
在大湖的前方一公里处的一处密林里，一个残破的元神正盘坐着吸收天地灵气在疗伤，吸收了不少的天地灵气，他的元神也恢复了一丝凝实，但还不是完全。
按照这种进度下去，他可能需要花费数年的时间才能够让自己的元神完全凝实，他就是鸿宇仙祖的元神。
本来他还想继续吸收天地灵气的，可是忽然四面八方的天地灵气往他布置的阵法入口处涌去，他的脸色一瞬间变得极为的难看，暴怒的吼声瞬间响彻云霄，“是谁来抢我的天地灵气?本祖要将你抽血炼金，挫骨扬灰。“
说完，他飞速的朝阵法入口遁去。
鸿宇仙祖的怒吼声将四周的灵兽都吓得四处逃窜而走，洛豪也听到了，大吃一惊，有些惊异鸿宇仙祖为何在这里。
本来想要逃走的洛豪转念一想，既然鸿宇仙祖能这样说，那就证明他的伤势还并没有好，自己未必就怕他。
随后洛豪站了起来，将黑蛛刀拿在手上，等待鸿宇仙祖的元神到来。
而鸿宇仙祖的元神来到洛豪的身前时，顿时一愣，“原来是你，你为什么能够来到我这里?“
鸿宇仙祖的愤怒一瞬间消了下去，看向洛豪的眼神也带了一丝忌惮之色。
他虽然只是随手布置的三级阵法，但他知道在横断山脉周围的修士，最高的阵法师也不过是二级巅峰，根本就不可能破得了他的三级防御阵法和三级幻阵。
而眼前这个结真初期巅峰的小小修士居然能够破掉他的是三级防御阵法和三级幻阵，让鸿宇仙祖不得不产生忌惮之色。
别看洛豪表面上只是结真初期巅峰，但那实力根本不在现在的他之下，当然他也知道那是因为他的实力没有恢复到巅峰，不然洛豪这种小角色，他一个眼神就能秒杀的。
“我为什么不能够来这里，你来的正好，我还没有找你算账了，上次我元神差点被你给吞噬掉，今天就拿你的元神来祭祀我的黑蛛刀，看招。“
洛豪话音刚落，黑蛛刀一挥，一道大约十丈长的刀幕轰然落下，这正是洛豪的浮沉刀。
但洛豪并没有只施展浮沉刀，他知道鸿宇仙祖根本不怕他的浮沉刀，所以洛豪全身凝聚真元成真火，然后将真火融入到了浮沉刀中。
这也是刚刚洛豪见到鸿宇仙祖时所顿悟出来的，毕竟鸿宇仙祖只是怕他的真火，那么他只要将真火融入浮沉刀中，就一定能给鸿宇仙祖的元神造成巨大的伤害。
于是一道大约十丈长的刀幕裹着庞大的火圈，带着炽热的温度，往鸿宇仙祖冲来，鸿宇仙祖见此情景哪里还敢硬接，迅速的一闪，躲开了这一击。

轰的一声巨响，远处的一棵大树被洛豪的浮沉刀给击中，然后瞬间化为了灰烬。
鸿宇仙祖见此情景顿时睚眦欲裂，这个地方可是他花费了不少精力弄出来的，而且还是为了培养他的元神的，而且他还在这里种植了塑体的灵草。
刚刚那棵大树也是一棵不错的灵宝，结果却被洛豪给毁灭了，鸿宇仙祖大喝一声，“住手，你到底想要怎么样?“
鸿宇仙祖可不敢在这里跟洛豪打起来，洛豪不怕毁坏这里的宝物，可他怕啊，那是他休养生息的地方，要不然的话，鸿宇仙祖早就施展他的噬神仙术，吞噬洛豪的元神了。
看到鸿宇仙祖不敢动手，洛豪心里忽然明白过来，于是冷笑一声，“不怎么样，只是来找你算账而已。“
这鸿宇仙祖可真是狂妄，叫他住手，他就住手，那可不是他洛豪了，不报之前被夺舍的仇，他就没必要修真了，于是洛豪再次挥出一刀，也是同样的浮沉刀带着真火轰向了鸿宇仙祖。
鸿宇仙祖恨不得生撕了洛豪，可是洛豪发来的一击，他还不得不避开，因为他的元神并没有恢复到之前的状态，根本就不可能对抗洛豪的真火。
轰的一声，又是一片灵草地被洛豪的真火浮沉刀席卷而尽，变成光秃秃的一片，就好像回到了原始沙漠一般。
鸿宇仙祖忽然冷静了下来，“你住手，我们商谈一下，你要什么，只要我有的，我都给你。“
洛豪将黑蛛刀挂在了背上，然后问鸿宇仙祖，“你都有什么东西?“
“一级到九级灵草，以及一级到九级的灵兽内丹，一级到九级的炼器材料，上品到极品的仙器，真级与仙级的功法，还有一些阵法玉简，就只有这些了。“
鸿宇仙祖冷冷的回复洛豪。
当然其实鸿宇仙祖还有一样东西没有说，那就是十大开天辟地之物的月桂树，这可是先天的十大灵根之一，就算是仙祖也不得不争抢的东西，鸿宇仙祖自然是要据为己有，怎么可能给洛豪。
content_en:
All the spiritual energy in the spiritual energy vortex rolled back down, and Luo Hao's momentum was slowly rising. After the baptism of spiritual energy, Luo Hao's strength became more solid, and his peak state in the early stage of Jizhen was also consolidated deeper.
It can be said that as long as he swallowed one more grass pill fruit, Luo Hao could break through to the middle stage of Jie Zhen, but Luo Hao did not do so.
What Luo Hao wants is to first find an alchemy furnace, and then use the alchemy furnace to refine the grass spirit pill. The effect of using it will be doubled. Of course, there is another situation where continuing to absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth in this way will also allow Luo Hao to break through to the middle stage of Jie Zhen.
In a dense forest one kilometer in front of the big lake, a broken Yuanshen was sitting cross-legged, absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth to heal his wounds. He had absorbed a lot of spiritual energy from heaven and earth, and his Yuanshen had also regained some solidity, but it was not complete yet.
If this progress continues, it may take him several years to completely solidify his soul. He is the soul of Hongyu Immortal Ancestor.
Originally, he wanted to continue to absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, but suddenly the spiritual energy of heaven and earth from all directions surged towards the entrance of the formation he had arranged. His face turned extremely ugly in an instant, and his furious roar instantly resounded through the sky, "Who is going to steal my spiritual energy of heaven and earth? I will draw your blood for alchemy, crush your bones and raise ashes."
After saying that, he quickly fled towards the entrance of the formation.
Immortal Ancestor Hongyu's roar scared the surrounding spirit beasts and fled in all directions. Luo Hao also heard it and was shocked. He was a little surprised as to why Immortal Ancestor Hongyu was here.
Luo Hao, who originally wanted to escape, then thought that since Immortal Ancestor Hongyu could say this, it proved that his injury was not healed yet, and he might not be afraid of him.
Then Luo Hao stood up, holding the black spider knife in his hand, waiting for the arrival of the spirit of Hongyu Immortal Ancestor.
When the soul of Immortal Ancestor Hongyu came to Luo Hao, he was stunned for a moment, "It turns out to be you, why can you come to me?"
Immortal Ancestor Hongyu's anger subsided in an instant, and his eyes looked at Luo Hao with a hint of fear.
Although he only casually arranged the third-level formation, he knew that among the monks around the Hengduan Mountains, the highest formation master was only the second-level peak, and it was impossible to break his third-level defensive formation and third-level phantom formation.
However, the little monk in front of him who was at the peak of his early stage of perfection was actually able to break through his third-level defensive formation and his third-level illusion formation, which made Immortal Ancestor Hongyu feel fearful.
Although Luo Hao appears to be at the peak of his early stage of Jie Zhen, his strength is not at all inferior to what he is now. Of course, he also knows that it is because his strength has not returned to its peak. Otherwise, a small character like Luo Hao can be killed instantly with just one look.
"Why can't I come here? You came just in time. I haven't settled the accounts with you yet. My soul was almost devoured by you last time. Today, I will use your soul to sacrifice my black spider knife. Let's see how it works."
As soon as Luo Hao finished speaking, he waved the black spider knife, and a sword curtain about ten feet long suddenly fell down. This was Luo Hao's floating knife.
But Luo Hao didn't just use the Floating and Sinking Knife. He knew that Hongyu Immortal Ancestor was not afraid of his Floating and Sinking Knife at all, so Luo Hao condensed the true energy all over his body into true fire, and then integrated the real fire into the Floating and Sinking Knife.
This is what Luo Hao realized when he saw Hongyu Immortal Ancestor just now. After all, Hongyu Immortal Ancestor is only afraid of his true fire, so as long as he integrates the real fire into the floating knife, he will definitely be able to cause huge damage to Hongyu Immortal Ancestor's spirit.
Then a curtain of swords about ten feet long was wrapped in a huge ring of fire, carrying a blazing temperature, and rushed towards Immortal Hongyu. Seeing this scene, Immortal Hongyu dared to take a hard blow, and quickly dodged and avoided the blow.
With a loud bang, a big tree in the distance was hit by Luo Hao's floating knife, and then instantly turned into ashes.
Immortal Ancestor Hongyu was furious when he saw this scene. He spent a lot of effort to build this place, and it was to cultivate his soul, and heBody-shaping spiritual herbs are also planted here.
The big tree just now was also a good spiritual treasure, but it was destroyed by Luo Hao. Immortal Ancestor Hongyu shouted, "Stop, what do you want?"
Immortal Ancestor Hongyu would not dare to fight with Luo Hao here. Luo Hao is not afraid of destroying the treasures here, but he is afraid. It is the place where he rests and recuperates. Otherwise, Immortal Ancestor Hongyu would have used his God-eating Immortal Technique to devour Luo Hao's soul.
Seeing that Immortal Ancestor Hongyu didn't dare to take action, Luo Hao suddenly understood, so he sneered, "It's not that great, I just came to settle accounts with you."
This Hongyu Immortal Ancestor was really arrogant. He would stop when he was told to stop. That was not him, Luo Hao. If he did not avenge his previous death, he would not have the need to cultivate. So Luo Hao swung his sword again, and the same floating knife struck Hongyu Immortal Ancestor with real fire.
Immortal Ancestor Hongyu wanted to tear Luo Hao alive, but he had to avoid Luo Hao's blow because his soul had not returned to its previous state, and it was impossible to resist Luo Hao's true fire.
With a bang, another piece of spiritual grassland was swept away by Luo Hao's True Fire Floating and Sinking Knife, turning it into a bare patch, as if he had returned to the primitive desert.
Immortal Ancestor Hongyu suddenly calmed down, "Stop, let's discuss it, whatever you want, as long as I have it, I'll give it to you."
Luo Hao hung the black spider knife on his back, and then asked Immortal Ancestor Hongyu, "What do you have?"
"Level 1 to level 9 spiritual herbs, level 1 to level 9 spiritual beast inner elixirs, level 1 to level 9 weapon refining materials, top-grade to top-grade immortal weapons, true-level and immortal-level exercises, and some formation jade slips, that's all."
Immortal Ancestor Hongyu replied coldly to Luo Hao.
Of course, there is actually one thing that Immortal Ancestor Hongyu has not mentioned, and that is the laurel tree, one of the ten most epoch-making things in the world. This is one of the ten innate spiritual roots. Even the Immortal Ancestor has to fight for it. Immortal Ancestor Hongyu naturally wants to keep it for himself, so how can he give it to Luo Hao.
